name: Text3dFlip

requirements: The text is ordinary text in the page from the server render, readable with no JavaScript, and read once by screen readers
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours with no effect
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
The hover trigger plays only where a real pointer exists, and also plays when focus is inside the element (for example when it wraps a link)
The element is not made focusable by this component
screenReader: Read as ordinary text: the effect is purely visual

description: Letters or words that flip over in 3D, when the pointer or focus arrives or once when the text comes into view.

trigger.description: hover flips on pointer over or focus inside; view flips once when the text scrolls into view.

stagger.description: Seconds between one unit and the next.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the text plainly. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

use_when: A heading or link label that should react to the pointer
A short title that flips in once
avoid_when: Text people must read while it is mid-flip
